## Summary

Adds a proposed cross-chain interoperability component and three function contracts to the machine-readable and human-readable component/function catalog.

### Catalog additions
- `COMP-XCHAIN-INTEROP` — normative cross-chain message/capability contract proposal.
- `FN-XCHAIN-001` — cross-chain message contract validation.
- `FN-XCHAIN-002` — chain capability and proof-policy resolution.
- `FN-XCHAIN-003` — replay-safe message lifecycle and reconciliation.

- No canonical runtime symbol or exact source SHA has been identified; this PR does not claim implementation or verification.
- Unknown consensus/finality remains `BLOCKED`; no bridge, mint, unlock, release or asset-transfer functionality is authorized.
- Normative work tracked in [atc-standards #110](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/atc-standards/issues/110), architecture in [ecosystem #126](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/126).
- Catalog now contains 31 component records and 101 function records in this branch, including proposed entries. Counts are not a completeness claim.

- Repository validator, source reconciliation, tests and exact-HEAD CI have **not** been run for this PR; no PASS is claimed.
